extracted.intended_audience: community journalists, local newsroom staff, journalism students, and researchers interested in hyperlocal news values
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and newsworthiness criteria for community / hyperlocal journalism focused on small towns, neighborhoods, and suburbs; describes story types, distinguishing news values, implicit evaluative criteria, and tensions for local reporters and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage Focus (Hyperlocal Newsworthiness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Locally-oriented, professional news coverage that focuses on city neighborhoods, individual suburbs or small towns, rather than metropolitan, state, national or world news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hyperlocal beats prioritize close-to-home events and people rather than wider regional or national issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: City council meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: City council meetings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A core local-government beat for accountability and local governance reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: School board meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: School board meetings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important for local education policy, decisions that affect families, and civic engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community events
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Community events
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical and identity-affirming reporting that connects readers to shared activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honor roll students
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Honor roll students
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personalizes education coverage and affirms local achievement and pride.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local high school sports
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Local high school sports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports team identity and local social cohesion; often a highly-read local beat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vandalism and minor crime
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Vandalism and minor crime
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers safety concerns that directly affect residents' daily lives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zoning issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Zoning issues
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local land-use stories with practical implications for readers and local economics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Births, marriages, deaths
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Births, marriages, deaths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community milestones that document life events and local connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local business openings/closings
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Local business openings/closings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals about local economy and employment; useful for practical service reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Church news
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Church news
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Religious institution coverage that often has wide local relevance in small towns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volunteer recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Volunteer recognition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affirms civic participation and celebrates local contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters from local readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Letters from local readers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages community conversation and reflects local opinions and concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local opinion / editorials
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focus: Local opinion / editorials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Op-eds and editorial stance tailored to local context and community values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic role — Build community welfare
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection-focused news value: civic role — Build community welfare
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local journalism should serve a civic function by strengthening community welfare rather than treating stories solely as isolated events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affirm community — Strengthen 'us-ness'
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection-focused news value: affirm community — Strengthen 'us-ness'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that reinforce shared identity and social cohesion are valued in small-town coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Celebrate locals — Positive coverage of neighbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection-focused news value: celebrate locals — positive coverage of neighbors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing positive recognition and human-interest coverage that highlights local people and achievements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hold local power accountable (without destroying relationships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection-focused news value: hold local power accountable without destroying relationships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accountability reporting is essential but must be balanced to preserve long-term community relationships and the reporter's ability to operate locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in community life
rubrics_metrics.description: Connection-focused news value: participate in community life — editor/reporter may be part of same institutions (e.g., church, school)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local journalists often participate in community institutions; this participation is understood as part of the hyperlocal role rather than inappropriate distance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage hits close to home for journalist
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal connection: coverage hits close to home for journalist too
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists are often community members whose proximity to stories affects reporting choices and perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Different from traditional norm of distance
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal connection: different from traditional journalistic norm of distance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hyperlocal journalism relaxes the strict reporter-detachment norm; proximity is a practical reality to be managed rather than avoided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporter is community member
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal connection: reporter is community member
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being a member of the community provides access and context but requires awareness of bias and relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bias toward local pride balanced with truth
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal connection: bias toward local pride balanced with truth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local journalists may favor boosterish coverage but must balance that impulse with accuracy and critical reporting when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyperlocal geography
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Hyperlocal geography — Within commuting distance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should be geographically proximate and directly relevant to residents who live and commute locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naming neighbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Naming neighbors — Specific identifiable people
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that name and identify local people increase relevance and community connection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic action enablement
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Civic action enablement — What can locals DO?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer stories that enable readers to take practical civic actions or respond to local issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identity-affirming
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Identity-affirming — Who 'we' are
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that affirm community identity and shared values strengthen collective belonging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relationship-aware reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Relationship-aware reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters must be mindful of interpersonal relationships in small communities when reporting and editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical service
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Practical service — Closures, weather, events
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide timely, actionable information that helps residents plan and respond to local conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local milestones
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Local milestones — anniversaries, retirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage of enduring local milestones that mark communal life stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local economic implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Local economic implications — Jobs at major employer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on stories that have measurable economic impacts on the local community, such as employment changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local governance
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Local governance — Council meetings, school board
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accountability and reporting on local government processes are central to hyperlocal newsworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local sports
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit local newsworthiness criterion: Local sports — Team identity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sports coverage fosters team and town identity and often drives local readership and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension: Critical reporting vs. community relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Tension: balancing critical reporting with maintaining community relationships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors and reporters must negotiate trade-offs between investigative/critical coverage and preserving needed social ties in a small community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension: Professional distance vs. community membership
rubrics_metrics.description: Tension: professional distance versus community membership
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions must account for the reporter's dual role as a professional and local resident; some loss of distance is expected and manageable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension: Hard news vs. boosterism
rubrics_metrics.description: Tension: hard news versus boosterism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newsrooms must balance serious investigative coverage with positive booster-style stories that celebrate community successes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension: Independence vs. economic dependence on locals
rubrics_metrics.description: Tension: editorial independence versus economic dependence on local advertisers/readers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small outlets face structural pressures from dependence on local advertising and need strategies to preserve editorial independence.
